about: A meadow on a bright day, and the arena of Kitten Survivors. GENERATED — run `node tools/make-kitten-survivors-meadow.mjs` to rebuild it; edits made here are lost on the next run. The top of the ground is y = 0. Inside the fence at 46 nothing the arena draws is taller than 0.5 m, so nothing hides the crowd. The direction every other lane matches is kitten-survivors/art/world/bible.md. Enemies are not placed here: a survivor's crowd arrives on a clock, not out of a level file.
